requestId.description: 本次写入的 UUID；重试复用同一值，不能自动换 ID 重放未知结果。

Returns exact version for updates; follows pagination via nextOffset. Text indices refer to this version only. Formulas are not executed; PDF extraction does not OCR scanned pages. Maximum input 20 MiB.

knowledge.name: kb_file_content_update
knowledge.description: Modify a saved file using expectedVersion from file_content_read. DOCX: set_text or append_paragraph; PPTX: set_text or append_slide_text; XLSX: set_cell (value, null to clear, or formula without leading =); UTF-8 files: replace_content. Does not execute formulas. Keeps untouched package parts and creates a new version. Refuses active online editing sessions and stale versions. PDF/legacy/binary formats use managed_file_upload replacement instead. After unknown results query operation_get with the same requestId.
